dag_update.py.description: Safely update the Hypothesis DAG with a cross-platform file lock. With dag_store and dag_project in research.yaml, the change is written as events to the shared DAG store, pushed with retry, and the YAML at dag_path is regenerated from the replay.

--dag.description: Path to the DAG file (default: hypothesis-dag.yaml; with a DAG store, the view at dag_path).

--no-store.description: Edit the YAML file directly even when research.yaml names a DAG store.

--parent.description: Parent Node ID (Required if action=add), or the new parent (Required if action=relink).

--hypothesis.description: Description of the new hypothesis (Required if action=add).

--metric.description: The evaluation metric. Must align with DAG primary metric (Optional).

--node-id.description: Node ID to change (Required if action is update, adopt, relink, set or note).

--adoption.description: Adoption state: is the finding live? Required if action=adopt.

--artefact.description: Path or symbol in the running system that would carry this finding (Optional).

--verification.description: Shell predicate that exits 0 while the claim still holds (Optional, but required for adopted/partial/contradicted to count as verified).

--adoption-note.description: Why the node sits at this adoption state (Optional).

--field.description: Field to set (Required if action=set). Not id or parent.

--value.description: Value to set, parsed as YAML (Required if action=set).

--note.description: Text appended to the node's notes (Required if action=note).

dag_store.py.description: The shared, event-sourced store for the hypothesis DAG. Every command also takes --store (clone path or URL) and --project (folder), which override dag_store and dag_project in research.yaml.

--store.description: Clone path, git URL or bare repository of the store (overrides dag_store).

--project.description: The project's folder in the store (overrides dag_project).

command.description: init: clone and create the project folder. import: seed an empty project from a YAML DAG. view: pull and regenerate the YAML view. report: concurrent edits, aliases, orphaned events. record: turn direct edits to the view into events. prune: archive closed nodes' events. verify: check replay reproduces a YAML file. sync: push anything unpushed.

--from.description: import: the YAML DAG to import (default: dag_path).

--view.description: view, record: the view file (default: dag_path).

--no-pull.description: report, verify: use the local clone as it is.

--days.description: prune: only nodes untouched this many days.

--dry-run.description: prune: list what would be archived.

--against.description: verify: the YAML DAG to compare with (Required for verify).

start-hypothesis.description: Design the scope and plan for a hypothesis node (Experimental Design).

progress-hypothesis.description: Activate or continue execution of a framed research item (Experimental Execution).

--wi-id.description: AAW Work Item ID e.g., WI-042

--clean-room.description: Enforce Clean Room verification against main branch to prevent worker bias.

reconcile.py.description: Reconcile the hypothesis DAG against the running system. Reports the gap, proposes nothing.

--cwd.description: Working directory adoption predicates run in.

--migrate.description: Seed a default adoption block on nodes that lack one, then exit.

--strict.description: Also fail when a node claims adoption without a predicate.
